reportMetadata.reportType: Data Center Infrastructure & Digital Twin Connectivity Validation Report
reportMetadata.facility: CondensAI Multi-Hall High-Density GPU Digital Twin

spatialHierarchy.description: Hierarchical campus/hall/rack/sled/GPU containment tree with strict spatial coordinates

hydraulicCoolingPrimaryLoop.flowArchitecture: Decoupled 2N Hydronic Secondary Circuit with Direct-to-Chip Cold Plates

thermalRecoveryAndAgmd.architecture: Counterflow Plate-and-Frame HX + 15,000 L Thermal Buffer + AGMD Desalination Skid

verificationChecks.rule: Exactly 4 Halls, 24 Racks, 144 Compute Sleds, and 144 GPU Accelerators
Zero Orphan / Disconnected Nodes (Every entity participates in at least 1 verified topology edge)
100% Direct-to-Chip Liquid Cold-Plate Inlets and Outlets Connected into Rack Manifolds & Central Headers
verificationChecks.details: Verified 144 / 144 GPU cold plates fully plumbed. Failed items: 0

verificationChecks.rule: Mass Flow Strict Conservation: sum(GPU_flow) = sum(Rack_flow) = sum(Hall_flow) = Facility_CDU_flow (10.8 kg/s)
Tier IV 2N Dual-Feed Electrical Concurrency: Every Compute Sled connected to both PDU A and PDU B
Spine-and-Leaf Fat-Tree Reachability: 100% Compute Sleds connected to ToR switches, Leaf switches, and 800G Core Spine
verificationChecks.details: 144 / 144 Servers connected via 200G DAC to Top-of-Rack switch. Disconnected: 0

verificationChecks.rule: Complete Waste-Heat Recovery to Freshwater Desalination Circuit: HX -> Buffer Tank -> AGMD Skid -> Distillate Reservoir & Return Stream
verificationChecks.details: Continuous closed loop verified with 324 L/h clean permeate yield and 35.6 g/kg brine reject.

verificationChecks.rule: All entities assigned deterministic finite [x, y, z] 3D spatial coordinates within data center envelope

metadata.fluid: Treated Deionized Water with Corrosion Inhibitors
